title: German Bundestag: International Parliamentary Scholarships: Programme Arab Countries
summary: A 1-month scholarship in Berlin for politically engaged graduates from Arab countries to experience the German parliamentary system.

degree_levels.notes: Aimed at graduates (people who already have at least one first academic degree, e.g. Bachelor).

subject_areas.notes: No specific academic subjects restricted, focused on political interest and graduates.

nationality.notes: Citizenship of a programme country from the Arab states region (Algeria, Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Morocco, Oman, Palestinian Territories, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Syrian Arab Republic (Syria), Tunisia, United Arab Emirates, Yemen).

residence.notes: "Country" is the country in which you are living and from which you are applying (from the listed Arab states).

mandatory.text: under the age of 35 at the start of the scholarship
very good knowledge of the German language, at least B2 level
interest in politics, as well as social/political commitment

funding.description: Scholarship of 700 EUR monthly. Costs of health, accident and personal liability insurance will be covered. Travel expenses to and from Berlin will be covered. Free accommodation.

application_rounds.notes: Current deadlines can be found on the programme website.

steps.text: Use the application portal on a desktop computer.
Submit the application form and required papers through the official application website.

sources.title: German Bundestag: International Parliamentary Scholarships: Programme Arab Countries - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: International graduates receive funding for a physical study and research programme in Germany.
